prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry and preferred channels (SEO, paid search, social, content, B2B demand gen, product-led growth, etc.). I can, however, help you find the best fit. A quick way to proceed:

Questions for you (answer any that apply):
- What are your primary goals? (brand awareness, lead gen, e‑commerce revenue, app installs, retention, etc.)
- Which channels matter most? (SEO, PPC/Google Ads, Facebook/IG, TikTok, LinkedIn, email, content, CRO)
- Monthly or project budget range?
- B2B or B2C? Target industries or customer profile?
- Do you prefer a large agency, boutique specialist, or freelance/consultant?
- Timeline (ongoing or short campaign)?

How I can help next:
- Based on your answers I’ll produce a shortlist of 4–6 SF agencies (with strengths, estimated pricing band, and relevant case studies) and recommended interview questions to vet them.
- Or I can point you to up-to-date review sites (Clutch, G2, Google My Business) and the filters to use.

Quick tips to evaluate agencies now:
- Look for case studies with KPIs that match your goals.
- Ask for references from clients in your industry or with similar budgets.
- Confirm reporting cadence, transparency of ad spend and fees, and who will actually do the work.
- Start with a small paid test project before committing to a long contract.

Tell me your goals and budget and I’ll give a tailored shortlist of San Francisco agencies.
